pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BIBLE BIBLE

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HOLY
Topic 2.1: The Bible BIBLE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Bible BIBLE. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is a Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected,
2. respect the Bible as a Holy book for their spiritual growth.
3. appreciate the Bible as a Holy Book in his/her daily life for spiritual growth.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. respect the Bible as a Holy book for their spiritual growth.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respect the Bible as a Holy book for their spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the Bible as a Holy Book in his/her daily life for spiritual growth.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the Bible as a Holy Book in his/her daily life for spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Bible BIBLE.
2. Explain The Bible BIBLE to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Bible BIBLE.
4. Show that you can: sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Bible BIBLE. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is a Bible?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected,
2. respect the Bible as a Holy book for their spiritual growth.
3. appreciate the Bible as a Holy Book in his/her daily life for spiritual growth.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
